item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-23
item.description: "APEC Chengdu Statement (July 23, 2026) becomes the first minister-level multilateral statement to include open-source AI cooperation — mainstreaming the 'strong security assurance' framing as the multilateral counterpart to Global Times' 'comprehensive AI governance' frame; Tech Times (July 14, 2026) documents that China's National AI Industry Investment Fund is the only voting shareholder in DeepSeek's $7.4B June 2026 round — a structurally new asymmetric-governance architecture ahead of a 2027 IPO target; CAICT (China Academy of Information and Communications Technology) receives OpenHarmony compatibility-certification cooperation-center qualification — extending OpenHarmony's certification instrument from company-ecosystem layer to national-regulatory layer; the 2026 China Linux Kernel Developer Conference opens registration — a China-prefix naming-politics extension; openKylin X-Kernel (Rust) emerges from lab — moving from research-stage to deployment-stage."
